explorer.title: Connections
explorer.emptyBody: Add a MySQL or PostgreSQL server to start browsing.
explorer.noDatabases: No databases visible to this user

deleteConnection.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteConnection.body: The saved settings and the password stored in your system keychain will be removed. The database itself is not touched.

connection.sqlserverNote: SQL Server support is planned for the next milestone.
connection.name: Name
connection.passwordSaved: Saved in your system keychain — leave blank to keep it.
connection.passwordHint: Stored in your system keychain, never in PuriCat's settings file.
connection.passwordWillClear: The saved password will be removed when you save.

tlsMode.prefer: Prefer — encrypt if the server supports it
tlsMode.require: Require — encrypt, do not verify the server
tlsMode.verify-ca: Verify CA — encrypt and verify the certificate
tlsMode.verify-full: Verify full — also verify the host name

connection.readOnlyHint: The server rejects every write made through this connection.
connection.sshPlanned: SSH tunnelling with host-key verification is planned for the next milestone.
connection.prodWarning: Production: consider enabling the read-only session.

welcome.title: Welcome to PuriCat
welcome.subtitle: A calm, spreadsheet-native home for your databases.
welcome.noRecent: Connections you open will appear here.
welcome.statusNote: PuriCat is being built in phases. Nothing below is simulated.

features.connections: Saved connections with passwords in the system keychain
features.engines: MySQL and PostgreSQL, with TLS and server-enforced read-only sessions
features.browse: Explore databases, schemas, tables and views across several servers at once
features.grid: Fast read-only data grid with sorting, paging and exact server-side values
features.themes: Light and dark themes, English and Thai
features.editing: Excel-style editing, staged changes and Smart Paste
features.ai: Claude Code and Codex agent with approval for every change

table.readOnlyPreviewHint: Editing arrives with the next milestone. PuriCat only runs SELECT here.
table.notConnectedBody: Connect to “{{name}}” to load this table.
table.missingConnectionBody: The tab points to a connection that was deleted.
table.unordered: No primary key — server order, paging may shift

ai.title: AI agent
ai.notInstalledBody: PuriCat talks to the {{name}} command-line tool that you install and sign in to yourself.
ai.signedOutBody: Run “{{command}}” in a terminal, then check again.
ai.comingTitle: Agent chat is not in this build yet
ai.comingBody: This panel currently only verifies that the CLI is installed and signed in. Conversations, schema context and the approval queue arrive in the AI milestone.
ai.policyTitle: How the agent will be allowed to work
ai.policy2: Every INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL needs your review and approval.
ai.policy3: Passwords and connection secrets are never sent to an AI provider.
